definitions.gloss: attendance at a ceremony, participation in a formal event
definitions.explanation: Attending a formal ceremony such as a wedding, funeral, or official event. More formal than simply attending; implies respectful participation.

examples.japanese: {葬儀|そうぎ}に{参列|さんれつ}する。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}に{参列|さんれつ}するために{礼服|れいふく}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I prepared formal attire to attend the wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: {式典|しきてん}には{多|おお}くの{関係者|かんけいしゃ}が{参列|さんれつ}し、{厳|おごそ}かな{雰囲気|ふんいき}の{中|なか}で{行|おこな}われた。
examples.english: Many officials attended the ceremony, which was held in a solemn atmosphere.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{葬儀|そうぎ}に{参列|さんれつ}する (attend a funeral)
・{結婚式|けっこんしき}に{参列|さんれつ}する (attend a wedding)
・{式典|しきてん}に{参列|さんれつ}する (attend a ceremony)
・{参列者|さんれつしゃ} (attendee, those in attendance)

Used specifically for formal ceremonies and rituals. For casual events like parties, {出席|しゅっせき} or {参加|さんか} are used instead.
